read.access: Verified human partners see only filings owned by their captured mailbox, or by the deal owner when mailbox ownership is absent.

fields.event_id: Filing event UUID, supplied to undo
fields.subject: Source email subject, null when unavailable
fields.sender_name: Source email sender display name, null when unavailable
fields.activity_version: Activity version recorded at filing, null for legacy events

undo: Send event_id and a new idempotency_key to undo-email-thread-filing. The server checks the recorded version and later filing events. Legacy events have no recorded version; the server still checks later events and the current deal. Refusals leave the filing intact.
consumer_adoption: The app must pin the producer and update contracts/carr-interface.v1.json before displaying these fields. Do not infer missing email fields or activity versions.

quality_report.scope: Shared aggregate, matching the existing proposal quality report. Counts only and never changes router policy.

automatic_filings.filed: Automatic thread filing events recorded within days, default 7, allowed 1-90.
automatic_filings.undone: Filings in that cohort with at least one linked undo receipt at read time, counted once per filing.
automatic_filings.undo_rate: undone divided by filed, or null for an empty cohort. Separate from proposal dismissal rates.
automatic_filings.over_threshold: True when filed is at least 10 and undo_rate is strictly greater than 0.05.
